description: Source code for the ChartRenderer React component in Apache Superset, responsible for rendering charts with support for context menus, filters, and lifecycle event handling.

classes.name: ChartRenderer
classes.description: React component class responsible for rendering charts with lifecycle management, context menu handling, and integration with Superset's charting infrastructure.

methods.name: handleAddFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to the chart via provided addFilter prop.

methods.name: handleRenderSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful chart rendering, logs render time and updates chart status.

methods.name: handleRenderFailure
methods.description: Handles chart rendering failure, logs error details.

methods.name: handleSetControlValue
methods.description: Sets control values via provided setControlValue prop.

methods.name: handleOnContextMenu
methods.description: Opens the context menu at specified coordinates with optional filters.

methods.name: handleContextMenuSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of context menu options.

methods.name: handleContextMenuClosed
methods.description: Handles closing of the context menu.

methods.name: handleLegendStateChanged
methods.description: Updates internal state when legend state changes.

methods.name: onContextMenuFallback
methods.description: Fallback handler for context menu event if plugin doesn't handle it.

methods.name: handleLegendScroll
methods.description: Updates legend index in state when scrolled.
